text:
Maya: kicking off a cautious rollout for feature/batch-optimizer in the EU change window. plan is small-step: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30%. pin v3.0.0 for EU cohort. manual holds at each gate.
Carlos: noted. flag key? want to lock the exact CLI so SRE can follow the steps.
Maya: flag is batch.optimizer.toggle.v3. rollout timings: 0.5% for 12m, then 2% for 12m, 10% for 18m, finally 30% for 8m. If p99 latency increases > 120ms or errors > 0.8% we pause and fallback. fallback target: v2.9.7.
deploy-bot: Received rollout request. queued. estimated start in 3m. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/batch-optimizer-rollout.
Noor: I'm on monitoring. I'm scoping alerts to region=eu only and adding a temporary dashboard tile for this rollout.
Oncall_Raj: standing by for manual unpin/rollback if needed. Also adding a short-term rate limiter to protect downstream.
Maya: paste command for everyone's reference:
```bash
# start EU staged rollout with manual gates
deploy-bot start-rollout
  --flag batch.optimizer.toggle.v3
  --cohort eu
  --plan "0.5@12m,2@12m,10@18m,30@8m"
  --pin eu=v3.0.0
  --fallback v2.9.7
  --notes "EU cohort safe rollout. monitor p99 and ERR. manual holds at each step." 
```
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled. RunId: rb-5999999991. Step1 (0.5%) will start at +3m. Manual hold enabled.
Carlos: double-checked: traffic-slice filter = cohort=eu (not global). Noor confirmed dashboards.
Noor: first metrics snapshot after step1: p50/p95/p99 = 45/120/210ms, errors 0.06%. all green.
Maya: advance to step2 (2%). leaving 3m hold window for regression watch.
Oncall_Raj: adding a shorthand rollback if we need it:
```bash
deploy-bot rollback --run rb-5999999991 --to v2.9.7 --reason "auto-or-manual-slo" 
```
Carlos: also note we should avoid rebalancing cache across versions during early steps. Noor, can you warm the per-cohort cache now?
Noor: warmed the cohort cache and pinned the prefix. Tail latency improved slightly.
Maya: documenting release note snippet here for later post in #release-notes:
"batch.optimizer: gradual EU rollout of v3.0.0 (0.5%/2%/10%/30%). Pinned cohort=eu to v3.0.0; fallback v2.9.7. Monitor p99 and error rate; manual holds at each gate."
deploy-bot: Step2 applied: 2% to v3.0.0 for cohort=eu. Hold awaiting manual confirm.
Noor: Step2 metrics are stable. p99 delta +15ms, errors 0.1%.
Maya: proceed to 10%. watch 10m closely and if anything looks off we'll pin-all to fallback.
Oncall_Raj: note for audit: if we hit auto-suspend, deploy-bot will pin traffic back to fallback and post an incident marker.
Carlos: thumbs up. I'll prepare the post-deploy checklist (notes on QA smoke tests and rollback evidence) once we hit 30%.
Maya: thanks everyone. keep convo here for the rollout log. :eyes:
